editorial.description_en: The dark that arrives ten minutes before a summer downpour and leaves twenty minutes after it.
editorial.description_ja: 夕立の前の空のような、暗い青。

provenance.derivation: Editorial construction, not a measurement. Specified in OKLCh as L 0.500, C 0.066, h 246.0° and converted to canonical D65 XYZ by @irodora/color-spaces 0.1.0 (oklchToXyz), rounded to six decimal places. Re-derivable from this sentence alone.
provenance.editorialNotes: Name coined by Irodora: 夕 (yū, evening) + 立ち (dachi, rising), after the standing word 夕立. It is not asserted to be a traditional Japanese colour name, and the hyphenated romaji marks it as a constructed compound (ADR-0065). "Sudden Shower" is an editorial decision about what communicates in English, not a literal translation of 夕立. Relations asserted from measured proximity under the current engine, not from a source: related is the three nearest in CIELAB — ame-iwa at ΔE00 4.6, en-yo at ΔE00 5.3, yoi-zora at ΔE00 6.9. complementary is the entry nearest the opposite OKLCh hue (66°), within 22°. historicalVariants is empty: this entry makes no historical claim to vary from.
